question: When do single-select preview questions offer notes, how does the editor behave, and how do notes reach the answer annotation?
answer: zet gates notes to a non-multi-select question whose options include a preview. In a3 a plain n (no ctrl/meta) opens the notes editor; Esc exits and keeps the text, Enter saves and takes an answer in order: moved option focus, the question's stored answer, then the (notes only) marker. P3 reads the per-question textInputValue only for zet questions, trims it and writes annotations.notes beside a full preview annotation. The product implements the same gate, a per-question notes map, the Notes row and the answer order, and passes notes through the grouped terminal answer path.

behavior.open: plain n on the option list, no ctrl or meta modifier
behavior.escape: exit the editor and keep the text
behavior.storage: per question, kept across step changes and review navigation
behavior.annotation: trimmed notes under annotations.notes, beside annotations.preview when the selected option carries a full preview
behavior.limit: 8192 characters in the product editor; the source path sets no hard cap

adaptations: Notes render as a dedicated Notes: row below the options and Other, with the edited value shown in the dialog answer row; the source renders the editor inside the question body.
The product treats n as ordinary text while the Other row has focus; the source preview component has no Other row, so the notes key only applies on option focus.
A notes-only answer is carried as other: "(notes only)" because the host answer contract requires exactly one selection for a single-select question.
The product caps notes at 8192 characters, matching the recovered annotation limit; the source editor itself sets no cap on this path.
The review page does not show notes, matching the source review component; clarify feedback's User notes: text is not ported.
residuals: Clarify feedback's User notes: text (Qet/nmo) is not ported.
